counter_rules.CH_DH: CH common PAPER_BASE PIB256 and DH active OO PIB128 are separate typed domains; generic DH front-end8 is inactive. Cross-design proxies do not establish equal structure or area.
counter_rules.additive: Only parser-certified cumulative additive metrics are differenced. First actual constructor-zero is explicit; later differences require both explicit endpoints and nondecrease. Missing endpoints yield null, never zero.
counter_rules.capture_source: Candidate source and exact trace identity remain distinct. myocyte accepted integration step/adaptive attempt IDs and 3DCONV scalar_i remain null. SRAD second-pass reduce is separate.
counter_rules.gauge_peak: Preserve print snapshots separately; never difference or sum. Running peak is not phase-local peak.
counter_rules.identity: Actual source profile/cohort/UUID/SHA governs; old comparison_profile aliases do not redefine original P0. No per-program best-profile selection.
counter_rules.mean_latency: Raw printed mean snapshots retain diagnostic sampling window; never difference, add, or promote to exact whole-application means. Missing means are not zero.
counter_rules.mechanism: Facts, source inference, correlation and unconfirmed cause remain distinct. Read-active print interval does not establish cold/compulsory/cache-miss origin.
counter_rules.phase_sums: A missing additive interval makes the formal phase total null with missing interval count; no partial total is represented as complete.

derived_parser.reuse: Frozen V1 line-streamed raw parser with four explicit patches in PARSER_REUSE_AND_PATCH_CONTRACT.json

execution: Root invokes once after qualified natural all48 terminal. No daemon, force flag, model/control mutation or Git publication.

publication.publish_only: Final MANIFEST.json and exactly its files entries, plus this preparation manifest. Do not recursively copy private, private_cpu_fixtures or updates staging.

qualification.scope: 26 CPU-only metadata and synthetic boundary checks. No final raw scan, service or driver execution.

resources.failure: Analysis HOLD on own memory/format/scope/size failure; no simulation rerun or upstream performance status change.
resources.parser_raw_read: Line-streamed, gzip SHA verified. Selected extracted Python objects are retained in memory; this is not constant-memory end-to-end.
resources.private_intermediate: Monolithic gzip JSON and logs are private staging only, never published members.

scope.first8_scope: Existing separately reviewed evidence linked with declared scope only; quantitative CORE32 comes from source-qualified provider.
